summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated Bun-only payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, at `npm install` time, downloads the Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, unpacks and chmod +x's it in a temp directory, then invokes the dropped `bun` binary against a bundled `math_init.js` in the package. `math_init.js` is a ~711 KB Bun-only bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) whose control flow is hidden behind a rotated string-array decoder (`WV8StW`, `hc1jfK9`) and hex-obfuscated identifiers (`_0x...`) in the preinstall script, so its behavior is not readable from source and cannot be evaluated by Node-based scanners. The package advertises itself as a React direct-mail UI component library, which has no need for a second JavaScript runtime or an opaque native-executed blob. The version metadata also jumps from 1.2.0 to 20.1.1, a pattern consistent with an account hijack or version-inflation squat. The alternate-runtime-dropper + obfuscated payload pattern gives whoever published this version arbitrary code execution on every installer's machine on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
